scope: bridgeable; final reporting budget; original stopped paths
criterion: finite nonempty returned interval with width <= 2 * tolerance
interpretation: Original release rule is R <= delta for both bridge and direct target policies.
Released outputs contain both point estimate and interval. Unreleased bridge outputs remain informative outer intervals.
Narrow unreleased intervals are not original releases. Their midpoint is a different possible estimator.
New stopping rules and acquisition costs cannot be inferred merely by relabelling original final records.
Nominal path coverage and participant cost assumptions are shared; actual coverage and information differ.
